literature.headline_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期基孔肯雅病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: IL-17A 信号传导的基因缺失显着增强了 I 型干扰素反应并降低了小鼠心脏中的病毒负荷。 [10.64898/2026.08.07.743518]
表面等离子共振证实与 CHIKV E1 和 E2 糖蛋白复合物直接、高亲和力结合 (K_D = 73 nM)。在致死性神经感染模型中,口服替巴尼布林可显着提高生存率并降低脑病毒载量;在关节炎模型中,它显着减轻了足垫肿胀和炎症病理。 [10.1111/bph.70642]
近 327 例(57%)病例被诊断为登革热,73 例(13%)病例被诊断为基孔肯雅热。与其他发热患者相比,DENV 感染患者的白细胞、红细胞和血小板计数显着下降 (P < .001)。 [10.1097/md.0000000000050108]
与健康对照相比,CHIKV 感染患者中除 TNF-α 外的所有可检测到的细胞因子均显着升高。细胞因子浓度根据患者病毒载量和临床表现而变化。 [10.1186/s41182-026-01041-2]

在 132 名分析患者中,40.2% 患有急性 CHIKV 感染。CART 分析将膝盖和肩部疼痛确定为潜在的预测因素,但仅正确分类了 67.4% 的患者,而漏掉了 71.7% 的病例(交叉验证的 AUC 53%;95%CI 43%-63%)。逻辑回归的准确度为 61.1%,相应的交叉验证 AUC 为 62% (95%CI 52%-72%)。 [10.1371/journal.pone.0355216]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Genetic deletion of IL-17A signaling significantly enhanced type I interferon responses and decreased viral burden in mouse hearts. [10.64898/2026.08.07.743518]
Surface plasmon resonance confirmed direct, high-affinity binding to the CHIKV E1 and E2 glycoprotein complex (K_D = 73 nM). [10.1111/bph.70642]

Nearly 327 (57%) cases were diagnosed with dengue fever, while 73 (13%) cases were for chikungunya. White blood cell, red blood cell, and platelet counts were significantly decreased among patients with DENV infection compared to other febrile patients (P < .001). [10.1097/md.0000000000050108]

All detectable cytokines except TNF-α were significantly elevated in CHIKV-infected patients compared with healthy controls. Cytokine concentrations varied according to patient viral load and clinical presentation. [10.1186/s41182-026-01041-2]

Of 132 analysed patients, 40.2% had acute CHIKV infection. CART analysis identified knee and shoulder pain as potential predictors, however classifying only 67.4% of patients correctly while missing 71.7% of cases (cross-validated AUC 53%; 95%CI 43%-63%). [10.1371/journal.pone.0355216]

news.headline_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期基孔肯雅病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 基孔肯雅热在哥斯达黎加再次流行 - qcostarica.com。 [news-8e5e8d4b5e681e40]
据报道,由于季风导致蚊子激增,基孔肯雅热病例有所增加;卫生当局加强了 监测 和 媒介 控制措施。 [news-11dcb8087328b34b]
喀拉拉邦卫生当局报告称,基孔肯雅热感染人数有所增加,有 105 例确诊病例和 62 例疑似病例,促使加强了 监测、媒介 控制工作和公众宣传活动。 [news-a96b6ba0659f86c9]
喀拉拉邦卫生当局报告了 105 例基孔肯雅热确诊病例,促使加强了 监测 和蚊虫控制措施。 [news-2a5d03e973c01eb4]
文章警告说,基孔肯雅热 可能会在几天内消失,但严重的关节疼痛、僵硬和肿胀可能会持续数周或数月。医生警告说,延迟 诊断 可能会使症状恶化,从而更难排除登革热。 [news-8a3783c1e0b44b7b]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Chikungunya virus news developments.
key_findings_en: Chikungunya is circulating again in Costa Rica - qcostarica.com. [news-8e5e8d4b5e681e40]
Reported rise in chikungunya cases amid monsoon-driven mosquito surge; health authorities intensifying surveillance and vector-control measures. [news-11dcb8087328b34b]

Kerala health authorities reported a rise in chikungunya infections, with 105 confirmed and 62 probable cases, prompting intensified surveillance, vector-control efforts, and public awareness campaigns. [news-a96b6ba0659f86c9]
Kerala health authorities reported 105 confirmed chikungunya cases, prompting strengthened surveillance and mosquito-control measures. [news-2a5d03e973c01eb4]

The article warns that Chikungunya fever may disappear within days, but severe joint pain, stiffness, and swelling can persist for weeks or months. Doctors caution that delayed diagnosis may allow symptoms to worsen and make it harder to rule out dengue. [news-8a3783c1e0b44b7b]

papers.title_zh: 为刚果民主共和国的 基孔肯雅热 制定临床病例定义
papers.source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: Chikungunya fever presents a diagnostic challenge in Sub-Saharan Africa due to the absence of a region-specific case definition, especially in settings with high disease burden and diverse aetiologies of acute febrile illnesses. Our study aimed to develop an evidence-based clinical case definition for acute Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infection suitable for use at resource-limited primary health care level. METHODS: We conducted a cross-sectional study in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, between June and November 2019 during an ongoing CHIKV outbreak. Patients aged ≥3 years with symptoms suggestive of acute CHIKV infection were enrolled. Clinical examination data and blood samples were collected for CHIKV diagnosis via PCR and ELISA. Malaria rapid diagnostic tests were also performed. We used Classification and Regression Tree (CART) analysis with 10-fold cross-validation and predictive logistic regression models with lasso penalty, with performance assessed via the Area under the Receiver Operating Characteristics Curve (AUC). RESULTS: Of 132 analysed patients, 40.2% had acute CHIKV infection. CART analysis identified knee and shoulder pain as potential predictors, however classifying only 67.4% of patients correctly while missing 71.7% of cases (cross-validated AUC 53%; 95%CI 43%-63%). Logistic regression achieved 61.1% accuracy, with a corresponding cross-validated AUC of 62% (95%CI 52%-72%). Exploratory analysis excluding malaria co-infections yielded similar CART performance, while logistic regression failed to identify any reliable predictors. CONCLUSIONS: While our study provides valuable insights into the clinical presentation of CHIKV in Sub-Saharan Africa, it highlights the challenges of developing a simple symptom-based diagnostic algorithm suitable for resource-limited primary health care settings. Certain joint pain patterns showed predictive value, however no model achieved sufficient accuracy for clinical use. Improved access to serological testing and integration of epidemiological context are essential for CHIKV diagnosis in such contexts. Further research is needed to refine clinical criteria and support outbreak response in resource-limited regions.

papers.title: Chikungunya Virus serological cross-reactivity in co-endemic settings: Mechanisms, Diagnostic implications, and epidemiological consequences
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) causes an acute febrile illness with debilitating arthralgia, and serological assays remain central to its diagnosis and surveillance. However, antibody-based results are complicated by cross-reactivity in settings where multiple arboviruses co-circulate. This review distinguishes three related but distinct phenomena affecting CHIKV serology: biological cross-reactivity, arising from genuine antigenic overlap between related viruses; assay-associated non-target reactivity, in which a diagnostic platform generates a positive signal without an established biological relationship between the viruses; and diagnostic misclassification, the downstream epidemiological consequence of conflating the two. Applying this framework to five virus pairs, we find that CHIKV–O'nyong-nyong virus (ONNV), CHIKV–Mayaro virus (MAYV) and CHIKV–Ross River virus (RRV) relationships are supported by shared alphavirus antigenic architecture and, in several studies, by functional cross-neutralisation. By contrast, CHIKV reactivity reported in dengue virus (DENV)- and Zika virus (ZIKV)-associated sera lacks an established biological basis and is better classified as assay-associated non-target reactivity of unresolved mechanism. These distinctions matter: unadjusted seropositivity can inflate or obscure CHIKV transmission estimates, and no single diagnostic platform resolves the problem for every virus pair. We argue that CHIKV diagnosis in co-endemic settings requires a layered strategy: molecular detection during the acute phase, antigenically informed and multiplex serology thereafter, and neutralisation-based confirmation where attribution is critical, combined with cross-reactivity-aware statistical modelling for surveillance. Strengthening assay validation and confirmatory testing, particularly in African settings such as Nigeria where CHIKV, DENV and related alphaviruses circulate together, is essential for improving diagnostic accuracy and epidemiological inference.

This review distinguishes three related but distinct phenomena affecting CHIKV serology: biological cross-reactivity, arising from genuine antigenic overlap between related viruses; assay-associated non-target reactivity, in which a diagnostic platform generates a positive signal without an established biological relationship between the viruses; and diagnostic misclassification, the downstream epidemiological consequence of conflating the two. Applying this framework to five virus pairs, we find that CHIKV–O'nyong-nyong virus (ONNV), CHIKV–Mayaro virus (MAYV) and CHIKV–Ross River virus (RRV) relationships are supported by shared alphavirus antigenic architecture and, in several studies, by functional cross-neutralisation. By contrast, CHIKV reactivity reported in dengue virus (DENV)- and Zika virus (ZIKV)-associated sera lacks an established biological basis and is better classified as assay-associated non-target reactivity of unresolved mechanism. These distinctions matter: unadjusted seropositivity can inflate or obscure CHIKV transmission estimates, and no single diagnostic platform resolves the problem for every virus pair. We argue that CHIKV diagnosis in co-endemic settings requires a layered strategy: molecular detection during the acute phase, antigenically informed and multiplex serology thereafter, and neutralisation-based confirmation where attribution is critical, combined with cross-reactivity-aware statistical modelling for surveillance. Strengthening assay validation and confirmatory testing, particularly in African settings such as Nigeria where CHIKV, DENV and related alphaviruses circulate together, is essential for improving diagnostic accuracy and epidemiological inference.

analysis.summary_en: This review addresses the diagnostic challenges posed by Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) serological cross-reactivity in co-endemic settings where multiple arboviruses circulate. It introduces a framework distinguishing biological cross-reactivity, assay-associated non-target reactivity, and diagnostic misclassification. Evidence supports shared antigenic architecture and functional cross-neutralisation between CHIKV and related alphaviruses such as O'nyong-nyong, Mayaro, and Ross River viruses. papers.abstract_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 会导致急性发热性疾病,并导致 关节痛 衰弱,血清学检测仍然是 诊断 和 监测 的核心。然而,在多种虫媒病毒共同循环的环境中,基于抗体的结果因交叉反应而变得复杂。本综述区分了影响 CHIKV 血清学 的三种相关但不同的现象:生物交叉反应性,由相关病毒之间真正的抗原重叠引起;与检测相关的非目标反应性,其中诊断平台在病毒之间没有建立生物学关系的情况下产生阳性信号;诊断错误分类,将两者混为一谈的下游流行病学后果。将该框架应用于五个病毒对,我们发现CHIKV-O'nyong-nyong病毒(ONNV)、CHIKV-Mayaro病毒(MAYV)和CHIKV-罗斯河病毒(RRV)关系得到了共享的甲病毒抗原结构的支持,并且在一些研究中还得到了功能性交叉中和的支持。相比之下,登革热病毒 (DENV) 和寨卡病毒 (ZIKV) 相关血清中报道的 CHIKV 反应性缺乏既定的生物学基础,最好归类为未解决机制的检测相关非靶标反应性。这些区别很重要:未经调整的血清阳性率可能会夸大或掩盖 CHIKV 传播 的估计值,并且没有一个诊断平台可以解决每个病毒对的问题。我们认为,共流行环境中的 CHIKV 诊断 需要分层策略:急性期进行分子检测,随后进行抗原告知和多重 血清学,以及基于中和的确认(其中归因至关重要),并结合 监测 的交叉反应感知统计模型。加强分析验证和确认性检测,特别是在尼日利亚等 CHIKV、DENV 和相关甲病毒共同传播的非洲地区,对于提高诊断准确性和流行病学推断至关重要。

papers.title: Dengue fever and chikungunya: prevalence, hematological parameters, and associated factors among febrile patients in eastern Ethiopia: A cross-sectional study
papers.abstract: Dengue fever and chikungunya are emerging arboviral diseases and are becoming major public health threats in tropical and subtropical regions. However, the actual burden and contributing factors are not well studied in Ethiopia. Thus, this study aimed to determine the prevalence of dengue fever and chikungunya and assess the hematological parameters and associated factors among febrile patients in eastern Ethiopia. An institution-based cross-sectional study was conducted in Dire Dawa city administration from October to December 2023. Sociodemographic and clinical information of patients were collected using a structured questionnaire and checklist. Hematological parameters were determined using the Mindray BC-3000 Plus automated hematology analyzer. The Kruskal-Wallis test, Spearman correlation test, and logistic regression were used during data analysis. A P-value of < .05 with a 95% confidence interval was considered statistically significant. A total of 576 febrile patients were investigated. The majority of the study participants, 312 (54.2%), were male, and 524 (91%) were rural residents. Nearly 327 (57%) cases were diagnosed with dengue fever, while 73 (13%) cases were for chikungunya. The type of visited healthcare institution (Sabian Comprehensive Hospital, AOR: 8.2 [95% CI: 4.02, 17.3] and Dilchora Referral Hospital, AOR: 2.3 [95% CI: 1.5, 3.7]), urban residence (AOR: 2.3, 95% CI: 1.37-7.7), government employment (AOR: 0.34 [0.12-0.99]), and patients' previous history of a similar AFI (acute febrile illness) AOR: 3.2 (95% CI: 1.02, 10.3) were significantly associated with empiric arboviral diseases. White blood cell, red blood cell, and platelet counts were significantly decreased among patients with DENV infection compared to other febrile patients (P < .001). In addition, a statistically significant weak negative correlation was noted between the duration of fever and white blood cell count, red blood cell count, and platelet count among dengue patients. High rates of clinical dengue fever and chikungunya cases were observed. Some socio-demographic and institutional factors were more likely to be significantly associated with clinically diagnosed arboviral diseases. Furthermore, significant differences were observed in some hematological parameters between cases with dengue/chikungunya diseases and those without. The findings highlighted the need for early diagnosis and urgent action to downplay the undesirable outcomes of arboviral diseases.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热和基孔肯雅热是新出现的虫媒病毒性疾病,正在成为热带和亚热带地区的主要公共卫生威胁。然而,埃塞俄比亚的实际负担和影响因素尚未得到充分研究。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2023年10月至2023年12月,德雷达瓦市政府进行了一项基于机构的横断面研究。共调查了576名发热患者。
elements_zh.methods: 使用结构化问卷和清单收集患者的社会人口学和临床信息。数据分析过程中使用了 Kruskal-Wallis 检验、Spearman 相关检验和逻辑回归。
elements_zh.main_results: 近 327 例(57%)病例被诊断为登革热,73 例(13%)病例被诊断为基孔肯雅热。与其他发热患者相比,DENV 感染患者的白细胞、红细胞和血小板计数显着下降 (P < .001)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 就诊的医疗机构类型、城市居住、政府工作以及患者既往类似 AFI 病史与经验性虫媒病毒性疾病显着相关。登革热患者的发热持续时间与白细胞计数、红细胞计数和血小板计数之间存在统计学上显着的弱负相关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调需要尽早采取 诊断 并采取紧急行动,以淡化虫媒病毒疾病的不良后果。临床登革热和基孔肯雅热病例的发病率很高。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report specific limitations of the study. A P-value of < .05 with a 95% confidence interval was considered statistically significant.

papers.title: Repurposing tirbanibulin as an orally active E2‐targeting entry inhibitor against Chikungunya virus
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) causes severe acute and chronic disease, yet no approved specific antiviral treatment exists. To rapidly identify potential treatments, we aimed to screen an FDA-approved drug library for inhibitors of CHIKV infection. Tirbanibulin, a dual-microtubule polymerization and Src kinase inhibitor, was assessed for its potential anti-CHIKV activity. METHODS: We performed a high-throughput screen of an FDA-approved drug library. Mechanism-of-action studies included entry-step analysis, surface plasmon resonance (SPR) binding assays and molecular docking. In vivo efficacy was evaluated in lethal murine neuroinfection and CHIKV-induced arthritis models following oral administration of the candidate compound. EXPERIMENTAL APPROACH: Tirbanibulin exhibited nanomolar to low-micromolar antiviral activity (EC50 range: 0.035-75.64 μM) across multiple cell lines, with high selective indices in key target HT22 and Huh7 cells. It acted at a post-attachment entry step, inhibiting clathrin-mediated endocytosis and potentially viral fusion. Surface plasmon resonance confirmed direct, high-affinity binding to the CHIKV E1 and E2 glycoprotein complex (K_D = 73 nM). In the lethal neuroinfection model, oral tirbanibulin significantly improved survival and reduced brain viral loads; in the arthritis model, it markedly attenuated footpad swelling and inflammatory pathology. CONCLUSION AND IMPLICATIONS: Tirbanibulin is a novel, orally bioavailable entry-stage inhibitor that directly targets the E2 glycoprotein. Multiple preclinical and clinical studies have confirmed its favourable oral bioavailability and safety. Given its established clinical safety profile, it represents a promising repurposing candidate for clinical evaluation against Chikungunya fever.

papers.title: IL-17A Restrains Antiviral Immunity to Promote Chikungunya Virus Infection and Pathogenesis in the Heart
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infection is increasingly linked to cardiovascular complications, but the mechanisms underlying CHIKV-induced cardiovascular disease (CVD) remain unclear, and targeted therapies are lacking. Although elevated interleukin-17A (IL-17A) levels have been reported in CHIKV patients and associated with cardiovascular pathology, its role in CHIKV-induced cardiac disease is poorly defined. To address this question, we employed our newly developed heterozygous interferon /{beta}/{gamma} receptor-deficient (Ifnag+/-) mice and primary human cardiac fibroblasts to investigate the contribution of IL-17A signaling to CHIKV-associated cardiac pathology. We found that CHIKV infection induced IL-17A production in the heart, and that mice deficient in Il17a (Il17a-/-) and in its receptor gene, Il-17ra (Il17ra-/-), exhibited marked resistance to CHIKV infection in both cardiac tissue and primary cardiac fibroblasts. Genetic deletion of IL-17A signaling significantly enhanced type I interferon responses and decreased viral burden in mouse hearts. Interestingly, blockade of IL-17RA with an FDA-approved monoclonal antibody for plaque psoriasis, Brodalumab, drastically increased type I interferon production and reduced viral replication in both human cardiac fibroblasts and human embryonic kidney 293 (HEK 293) cells. In addition, inhibition of IL-17A signaling suppressed the expression of pro-inflammatory mediators, including Il-1{beta}, Tnf-, and Cxcl2, reduced immune cell infiltration into cardiac tissue, and mitigated cardiac injury. Importantly, therapeutic blockade of IL-17A signaling after CHIKV infection reduced viral replication in both the heart and circulation. Collectively, these findings identify IL-17A signaling as a critical regulator of CHIKV replication and cardiac inflammation and highlight the IL-17A/IL-17RA axis as a promising therapeutic target for CHIKV-associated cardiovascular disease.

source_records.title: IL-17A Restrains Antiviral Immunity to Promote Chikungunya Virus Infection and Pathogenesis in the Heart
source_records.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infection is increasingly linked to cardiovascular complications, but the mechanisms underlying CHIKV-induced cardiovascular disease (CVD) remain unclear, and targeted therapies are lacking. Although elevated interleukin-17A (IL-17A) levels have been reported in CHIKV patients and associated with cardiovascular pathology, its role in CHIKV-induced cardiac disease is poorly defined. Collectively, these findings identify IL-17A signaling as a critical regulator of CHIKV replication and cardiac inflammation and highlight the IL-17A/IL-17RA axis as a promising therapeutic target for CHIKV-associated cardiovascular disease.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of IL-17A signaling in Chikungunya virus (CHIKV)-induced cardiovascular disease. The research highlights that IL-17A promotes CHIKV infection and pathogenesis in the heart by suppressing type I interferon responses and increasing viral burden. The findings demonstrate that blocking IL-17RA with Brodalumab enhances type I interferon production and reduces viral replication in both human cardiac fibroblasts and HEK 293 cells. The study uses genetically modified mice and human cell models to explore these mechanisms, providing insights into the pathogenesis of CHIKV and its impact on the cardiovascular system.

papers.abstract_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 感染与心血管并发症的关系越来越密切,但 CHIKV 诱发心血管疾病 (CVD) 的机制仍不清楚,且缺乏靶向治疗。尽管据报道 CHIKV 患者中白细胞介素 17A (IL-17A) 水平升高且与心血管病理相关,但其在 CHIKV 诱发的心脏病中的作用尚不清楚。为了解决这个问题,我们利用新开发的杂合干扰素/{β}/{γ}受体缺陷(Ifnag+/-)小鼠和原代人心脏成纤维细胞来研究IL-17A信号传导对CHIKV相关心脏病理学的贡献。我们发现CHIKV感染诱导心脏产生IL-17A,并且缺乏Il17a(Il17a-/-)及其受体基因Il-17ra(Il17ra-/-)的小鼠在心脏组织和原代心脏成纤维细胞中表现出对CHIKV感染的显着抵抗力。IL-17A 信号传导的基因缺失显着增强了 I 型干扰素反应并降低了小鼠心脏中的病毒负荷。有趣的是,用 FDA 批准的治疗斑块型银屑病的单克隆抗体 Brodalumab 阻断 IL-17RA,可显着增加人心脏成纤维细胞和人胚肾 293 (HEK 293) 细胞中 I 型干扰素的产生并减少病毒复制。此外,抑制IL-17A信号传导可抑制促炎介质的表达,包括IL-1{β}、Tnf-和Cxcl2,减少免疫细胞浸润到心脏组织,并减轻心脏损伤。重要的是,CHIKV 感染后治疗性阻断 IL-17A 信号传导可减少心脏和循环中的病毒复制。总的来说,这些发现确定 IL-17A 信号传导是 CHIKV 复制和心脏炎症的关键调节因子,并强调 IL-17A/IL-17RA 轴是 CHIKV 相关心血管疾病的有希望的治疗靶点。

papers.title: Chikungunya Vaccines in Travel Medicine: From Regulatory Approval to Real-World Challenges
papers.abstract: Background: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infection is an emerging disease of growing concern to international travelers due to the expanding geographic distribution of competent vectors, climate change, and frequent outbreaks in endemic and previously unaffected regions. Until recently, prevention relied exclusively on vector control and bite prevention; however, the recent approval of chikungunya vaccines has introduced a new preventive strategy. Methods: We conducted a narrative review of currently licensed chikungunya vaccines and candidates in clinical development, focusing on immunogenicity, safety, regulatory status, and implications for travel medicine practice. Results: Two vaccines have recently received regulatory approval: the live-attenuated vaccine IXCHIQ® and the virus-like particle vaccine Vimkunya®. Both demonstrated high immunogenicity based on neutralizing antibody thresholds accepted as surrogate markers of protection. Post-marketing safety signals associated with IXCHIQ®, particularly in older adults, have led to divergent regulatory decisions between authorities. The indication of vaccination in national recommendations varies somewhat depending on age, duration of travel, and individual risk factors. Several additional vaccine platforms remain under investigation, although some candidates have been discontinued. Conclusions: The recent approval of chikungunya vaccines marks a significant milestone in the field of travel medicine. However, uncertainties regarding long-term protection, safety in specific populations, and optimal targeting of travelers remain. Individualized risk–benefit assessment is essential, and further data are needed to refine vaccination strategies for travelers and populations at risk.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infection, its expanding geographic distribution driven by competent vectors and climate change, and the central question of how recently approved chikungunya vaccines integrate into travel medicine as a new preventive strategy.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: A narrative review was conducted focusing on licensed chikungunya vaccines and candidates in clinical development, explicitly addressing immunogenicity, safety, regulatory status, and implications for travel medicine practice.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Two vaccines have received regulatory approval: the live-attenuated vaccine IXCHIQ® and the virus-like particle vaccine Vimkunya®, both demonstrating high immunogenicity based on neutralizing antibody thresholds accepted as surrogate markers of protection.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Post-marketing safety signals associated with IXCHIQ®, particularly in older adults, have led to divergent regulatory decisions between authorities, indicating unresolved safety concerns in specific populations.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Individualized risk–benefit assessment is essential for vaccination strategies, and further data are needed to refine targeting of travelers and populations at risk, particularly regarding long-term protection and safety in specific groups.

analysis.summary_en: This review addresses chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infection as an emerging travel-related disease with expanding geographic risk due to vectors and climate change. It evaluates the integration of newly approved chikungunya vaccines into travel medicine, highlighting two licensed vaccines—IXCHIQ® (live-attenuated) and Vimkunya® (virus-like particle)—both showing high immunogenicity via neutralizing antibody surrogate markers. Regulatory and safety discrepancies, especially for IXCHIQ® in older adults, underscore unresolved concerns. The review emphasizes the need for individualized risk–benefit assessments and additional data to optimize vaccination strategies for travelers and at-risk populations, particularly regarding long-term protection and safety profiles.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 感染是一种新出现的疾病,由于 媒介 的地理分布不断扩大、气候变化以及 暴发 在流行地区和以前未受影响的地区频繁出现,国际旅行者日益关注。直到最近,预防还完全依赖于 媒介 控制和咬伤预防。然而,最近批准的基孔肯雅热疫苗引入了新的预防策略。方法:我们对目前获得许可的基孔肯雅病毒 疫苗 和临床开发中的候选药物进行了叙述性回顾,重点关注免疫原性、安全性、监管状况以及对旅行医学实践的影响。结果:两种 疫苗 最近获得了监管部门的批准:减毒活 疫苗 IXCHIQ® 和病毒样颗粒 疫苗 Vimkunya®。两者均表现出基于中和抗体阈值的高免疫原性,该阈值被接受为保护的替代标记。与 IXCHIQ® 相关的上市后安全信号,尤其是老年人的安全信号,导致监管机构之间的监管决策存在分歧。国家建议中 疫苗接种 的指示因年龄、旅行持续时间和个人风险因素而有所不同。尽管一些候选平台已停止使用,但其他几个 疫苗 平台仍在接受调查。结论:基孔肯雅热 疫苗 的近期批准标志着旅行医学领域的一个重要里程碑。然而,长期保护、特定人群的安全性以及旅行者的最佳目标仍然存在不确定性。个性化的风险效益评估至关重要,需要进一步的数据来完善针对旅行者和高危人群的 疫苗接种 策略。

papers.title: IN SILICO EVALUATION OF ANTIVIRAL POTENTIAL OF EMBLICA OFFICINALIS PHYTOCONSTITUENTS TARGETING CHIKUNGUNYA VIRUS NSP3 PROTEIN
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), an emerging arbovirus belonging to the genus Alphavirus (family Togaviridae), poses a significant global health challenge due to the absence of specific antiviral therapeutics. The present study investigates the antiviral potential of phytoconstituents from Emblica officinalis against the non-structural protein 3 (nsP3), a key component involved in viral replication, using in silico approaches. A set of selected phytochemicals was screened through molecular docking using AutoDock, followed by pharmacokinetic evaluation via ADMET analysis. Among the compounds, alpha-carotene, beta-sitosterol, kaempferol, and lupeol exhibited notable binding affinities toward the nsP3 protein. Interaction analysis indicated that hydrophobic interactions predominantly contributed to ligand binding. Furthermore, molecular dynamics simulation of the top-ranked complex demonstrated structural stability, with minimal conformational deviations observed over a 100 ns simulation period. These findings suggest that bioactive compounds from E. officinalis may serve as promising candidates for the development of anti-CHIKV therapeutics. However, further experimental validation is required to confirm their efficacy and safety.

Using molecular docking and ADMET analysis, four compounds—alpha-carotene, beta-sitosterol, kaempferol, and lupeol—showed notable binding affinities to nsP3. Molecular dynamics simulation of the top-ranked complex revealed structural stability over a 100 ns period. The authors propose these compounds as promising candidates for anti-CHIKV therapeutics, emphasizing the need for experimental validation to confirm efficacy and safety. While the findings suggest potential for phytoconstituent-based antiviral development, the in silico design limits immediate clinical applicability.

papers.abstract_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 是一种新兴的虫媒病毒,属于甲病毒属(披膜病毒科),由于缺乏特定的 抗病毒药物 疗法,对全球健康构成了重大挑战。本研究采用计算机模拟方法,研究了余甘子植物成分对抗非结构蛋白 3 (nsP3) 的 抗病毒药物 潜力,非结构蛋白 3 (nsP3) 是参与病毒复制的关键成分。使用 AutoDock 通过分子对接筛选出一组选定的植物化学物质,然后通过 ADMET 分析进行药代动力学评估。在这些化合物中,α-胡萝卜素、β-谷甾醇、山奈酚和羽扇豆醇对 nsP3 蛋白表现出显着的结合亲和力。相互作用分析表明疏水相互作用主要促进配体结合。此外,排名靠前的复合物的分子动力学模拟证明了结构稳定性,在 100 ns 的模拟时间内观察到的构象偏差最小。这些发现表明,来自 E. officinalis 的生物活性化合物可能作为开发抗 CHIKV 疗法的有希望的候选者。然而,需要进一步的实验验证来确认其功效和安全性。

papers.title: Coinfections of Chikungunya, Dengue, and Zika Viruses in India: Rationale for a Unified Triple Surveillance Approach
papers.abstract: Aedes -borne arboviruses are a major public health threat in India and globally. Arboviruses spread by the Aedes mosquito, namely, the Zika, chikungunya, and dengue viruses, pose overlapping and significant threats. In the Indian context, dengue is widespread and hyperendemic across many regions of the country, chikungunya has re-emerged markedly since the mid-2000s, and Zika outbreaks have appeared sporadically across several states. Because these viruses share the same mosquito vectors, the chances of coinfection and cocirculation increase, making diagnosis difficult. Moreover, clinical manifestations might become more complex in such coinfection scenarios. Despite this reality, most surveillance efforts look at each disease separately. In the present study, we review evidence of coinfection of dengue, chikungunya, and Zika in India, identify diagnostic and surveillance gaps, and propose an integrated “triple surveillance” approach to better track and manage these viral diseases.
papers.journal: The American Journal of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene

papers.title_zh: 印度基孔肯雅热、登革热和寨卡病毒的混合感染:统一三重 监测 方法的基本原理
papers.source_body_en: Aedes -borne arboviruses are a major public health threat in India and globally. Arboviruses spread by the Aedes mosquito, namely, the Zika, chikungunya, and dengue viruses, pose overlapping and significant threats. In the Indian context, dengue is widespread and hyperendemic across many regions of the country, chikungunya has re-emerged markedly since the mid-2000s, and Zika outbreaks have appeared sporadically across several states. Because these viruses share the same mosquito vectors, the chances of coinfection and cocirculation increase, making diagnosis difficult. Moreover, clinical manifestations might become more complex in such coinfection scenarios. Despite this reality, most surveillance efforts look at each disease separately. In the present study, we review evidence of coinfection of dengue, chikungunya, and Zika in India, identify diagnostic and surveillance gaps, and propose an integrated “triple surveillance” approach to better track and manage these viral diseases.
papers.abstract_zh: 伊蚊传播的虫媒病毒是印度和全球的主要公共卫生威胁。由伊蚊传播的虫媒病毒,即寨卡病毒、基孔肯雅病毒和登革热病毒,构成了重叠的重大威胁。在印度,登革热在该国许多地区广泛流行,基孔肯雅热自 2000 年代中期以来明显重新出现,寨卡病毒 暴发 在多个邦零星出现。由于这些病毒共享同一个蚊子媒介,因此同时感染和共循环的机会增加,使得诊断变得困难。此外,在这种合并感染的情况下,临床表现可能会变得更加复杂。尽管存在这样的现实,大多数 监测 的努力还是分别针对每种疾病。在本研究中,我们回顾了印度登革热、基孔肯雅热和寨卡病毒混合感染的证据,确定了诊断和 监测 方面的差距,并提出了一种综合的“三重 监测”方法来更好地跟踪和管理这些病毒性疾病。

papers.title: Comparing Adverse Health Outcomes in Infants Born to Women Monoinfected with Zika Virus or Infected with Both Zika and Chikungunya Viruses during Pregnancy: A Prospective Cohort Study in Pernambuco, Brazil (2015–2017)
papers.abstract: The association between Zika virus (ZIKV) infection in pregnant women and congenital defects is well-established. However, the consequences of infection with both ZIKV and Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) during pregnancy remain poorly understood. The aim for the present study was to estimate and compare the risk of adverse outcomes in infants born to mothers infected with ZIKV alone and those born to mothers infected with both ZIKV and CHIKV during pregnancy. A cohort study was conducted, following pregnant women with rash who were reported to the Strategic Health Surveillance Information Center of the State of Pernambuco between 2015 and 2017 and underwent laboratory testing for ZIKV and CHIKV. All participants resided within a 120-kilometer radius of the city of Recife, Pernambuco, Brazil. Newborns were monitored through standardized assessments conducted by specialists from the Microcephaly Epidemic Research Group. Adverse outcomes were compared between newborns prenatally exposed to ZIKV alone and those exposed to both ZIKV and CHIKV using descriptive statistics, as well as RRs. A total of 278 children ( n = 198 exposed to ZIKV alone; n = 80 exposed to ZIKV and CHIKV) were included. No significant differences were observed between the groups in the offspring’s risks of microcephaly, low birth weight, prematurity, small for gestational age, dysphagia, neurological, ophthalmological, audiological, or neuroimaging abnormalities. Although previous studies have revealed that each infection independently may be associated with adverse outcomes in newborns, the present study generally revealed no difference in the frequency or type of adverse effects in children born to mothers infected with both ZIKV and CHIKV compared with those exposed only to ZIKV during pregnancy.

Juliana Menezes Soares de Souza Aze Fontes

analysis.research_question_and_background: Zika virus (ZIKV) infection during pregnancy is known to cause congenital defects, but the additional impact of concurrent Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infection remains unclear. This study addressed the knowledge gap by comparing adverse infant outcomes between mothers monoinfected with ZIKV and those co-infected with ZIKV and CHIKV during pregnancy.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A prospective cohort study was conducted in Pernambuco, Brazil, between 2015 and 2017, enrolling pregnant women with rash reported to the Strategic Health Surveillance Information Center. Participants resided within a 120-kilometer radius of Recife, and newborns were monitored by specialists from the Microcephaly Epidemic Research Group. The study included 278 children, with 198 exposed to ZIKV alone and 80 exposed to both ZIKV and CHIKV.
analysis.methods: Laboratory testing for ZIKV and CHIKV was performed on pregnant women, and adverse outcomes in infants were compared between the two exposure groups using descriptive statistics and relative risks (RRs). Standardized assessments by specialists were used to evaluate outcomes such as microcephaly, low birth weight, prematurity, and neurological abnormalities.
analysis.main_results: No significant differences were observed between the groups in the risks of microcephaly, low birth weight, prematurity, small for gestational age, dysphagia, neurological, ophthalmological, audiological, or neuroimaging abnormalities. The study found no difference in the frequency or type of adverse effects in children born to mothers infected with both ZIKV and CHIKV compared with those exposed only to ZIKV during pregnancy.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as indicating that concurrent CHIKV infection does not exacerbate the adverse outcomes associated with ZIKV monoinfection during pregnancy. The novelty lies in directly comparing co-infection versus monoinfection within a prospective cohort, addressing a previously understudied question.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that surveillance and clinical management of ZIKV-exposed pregnancies may not require modification for concurrent CHIKV infection. This supports targeted public health strategies focused on ZIKV alone in regions where both viruses co-circulate.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its observational design, potential unmeasured confounding, and the lack of randomization, which constrains causal inference. The evidence strength is moderate due to the relatively small sample size and reliance on descriptive and RR-based comparisons without adjustment for confounders.

analysis.summary_en: This prospective cohort study in Pernambuco, Brazil (2015–2017) compared adverse infant outcomes between mothers monoinfected with Zika virus (ZIKV) and those co-infected with ZIKV and Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) during pregnancy. Among 278 infants, no significant differences were found in risks of microcephaly, low birth weight, prematurity, or other adverse outcomes between the two exposure groups. The authors concluded that concurrent CHIKV infection does not exacerbate ZIKV-associated adverse outcomes. These findings support continued focus on ZIKV-specific surveillance and management in co-endemic settings, though the observational design and modest sample size limit causal inference and generalizability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 众所周知,怀孕期间感染寨卡病毒 (ZIKV) 会导致先天性缺陷,但同时感染 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 的额外影响仍不清楚。这项研究通过比较怀孕期间单独感染 ZIKV 的母亲与同时感染 ZIKV 和 CHIKV 的母亲之间的不良婴儿结局,解决了知识差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 巴西伯南布哥州于2015年至2017年间开展了一项名为队列研究的前瞻性研究,纳入报告出现皮疹并向战略健康监测信息中心报告的孕妇。参与者居住在距离累西腓120公里范围内,新生儿由微小头畸形疫情研究小组的专家进行监测。该研究共纳入278名儿童,其中198名仅暴露于寨卡病毒(ZIKV),80名同时暴露于寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)。
elements_zh.methods: 对孕妇进行了 ZIKV 和 CHIKV 的实验室检测,并使用描述性统计数据和相对风险 (RR) 比较了两个暴露组之间婴儿的不良后果。专家的标准化评估用于评估小头畸形、低出生体重、早产和神经异常等结果。
elements_zh.main_results: 各组之间在小头畸形、低出生体重、早产、小于胎龄、吞咽困难、神经、眼科、听力或神经影像学异常的风险方面没有观察到显着差异。研究发现,与在怀孕期间仅接触 ZIKV 的母亲相比,同时感染 ZIKV 和 CHIKV 的母亲所生的孩子所生的不良反应的频率或类型没有差异。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,这些发现表明,并发 CHIKV 感染不会加剧妊娠期间与 ZIKV 单一感染相关的不良后果。新颖之处在于直接比较预期 队列研究 中的混合感染与单一感染,解决了之前未充分研究的问题。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,监测 和 ZIKV 暴露妊娠的临床管理可能不需要针对并发 CHIKV 感染进行修改。这支持了在两种病毒共同传播的地区仅针对 ZIKV 的有针对性的公共卫生战略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到观察设计、潜在的无法测量的混杂因素以及缺乏随机性的限制,从而限制了因果推断。由于样本量相对较小,并且依赖描述性比较和基于 RR 的比较,且未对混杂因素进行调整,因此证据强度中等。

analysis_en.methods: Laboratory testing for ZIKV and CHIKV was performed on pregnant women, and adverse outcomes in infants were compared between the two exposure groups using descriptive statistics and relative risks (RRs). Standardized assessments by specialists were used to evaluate outcomes such as microcephaly, low birth weight, prematurity, and neurological abnormalities.
analysis_en.main_results: No significant differences were observed between the groups in the risks of microcephaly, low birth weight, prematurity, small for gestational age, dysphagia, neurological, ophthalmological, audiological, or neuroimaging abnormalities. The study found no difference in the frequency or type of adverse effects in children born to mothers infected with both ZIKV and CHIKV compared with those exposed only to ZIKV during pregnancy.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as indicating that concurrent CHIKV infection does not exacerbate the adverse outcomes associated with ZIKV monoinfection during pregnancy. The novelty lies in directly comparing co-infection versus monoinfection within a prospective cohort, addressing a previously understudied question.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that surveillance and clinical management of ZIKV-exposed pregnancies may not require modification for concurrent CHIKV infection. This supports targeted public health strategies focused on ZIKV alone in regions where both viruses co-circulate.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its observational design, potential unmeasured confounding, and the lack of randomization, which constrains causal inference. The evidence strength is moderate due to the relatively small sample size and reliance on descriptive and RR-based comparisons without adjustment for confounders.

papers.title_zh: 比较怀孕期间单一感染寨卡病毒或同时感染寨卡病毒和 基孔肯雅病毒 的妇女所生婴儿的不良健康结果:巴西伯南布哥州的一项前瞻性 队列研究 研究(2015-2017 年)
papers.source_body_en: The association between Zika virus (ZIKV) infection in pregnant women and congenital defects is well-established. However, the consequences of infection with both ZIKV and Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) during pregnancy remain poorly understood. The aim for the present study was to estimate and compare the risk of adverse outcomes in infants born to mothers infected with ZIKV alone and those born to mothers infected with both ZIKV and CHIKV during pregnancy. A cohort study was conducted, following pregnant women with rash who were reported to the Strategic Health Surveillance Information Center of the State of Pernambuco between 2015 and 2017 and underwent laboratory testing for ZIKV and CHIKV. All participants resided within a 120-kilometer radius of the city of Recife, Pernambuco, Brazil. Newborns were monitored through standardized assessments conducted by specialists from the Microcephaly Epidemic Research Group. Adverse outcomes were compared between newborns prenatally exposed to ZIKV alone and those exposed to both ZIKV and CHIKV using descriptive statistics, as well as RRs. A total of 278 children ( n = 198 exposed to ZIKV alone; n = 80 exposed to ZIKV and CHIKV) were included. No significant differences were observed between the groups in the offspring’s risks of microcephaly, low birth weight, prematurity, small for gestational age, dysphagia, neurological, ophthalmological, audiological, or neuroimaging abnormalities. Although previous studies have revealed that each infection independently may be associated with adverse outcomes in newborns, the present study generally revealed no difference in the frequency or type of adverse effects in children born to mothers infected with both ZIKV and CHIKV compared with those exposed only to ZIKV during pregnancy.
papers.abstract_zh: 孕妇感染寨卡病毒 (ZIKV) 与先天性缺陷之间的关联已得到充分证实。然而,人们对怀孕期间感染 ZIKV 和 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 的后果仍知之甚少。本研究的目的是估计和比较仅感染 ZIKV 的母亲所生的婴儿以及怀孕期间同时感染 ZIKV 和 CHIKV 的母亲所生的婴儿的不良后果风险。一项 队列研究 研究对 2015 年至 2017 年间向伯南布哥州战略健康 队列研究 信息中心报告的出现皮疹的孕妇进行了跟踪,并接受了 ZIKV 和 CHIKV 实验室检测。所有参与者均居住在巴西伯南布哥州累西腓市 120 公里半径范围内。小头畸形流行病研究小组的专家通过标准化评估对新生儿进行监测。使用描述性统计数据和 RR,对产前单独暴露于 ZIKV 的新生儿和同时暴露于 ZIKV 和 CHIKV 的新生儿的不良后果进行了比较。总共包括 278 名儿童(n = 198 名仅接触过 ZIKV;n = 80 名接触过 ZIKV 和 CHIKV)。各组之间在后代小头畸形、低出生体重、早产、小于胎龄、吞咽困难、神经、眼科、听力或神经影像异常的风险方面没有观察到显着差异。尽管之前的研究表明,每种感染可能独立地与新生儿的不良后果相关,但本研究总体显示,与妊娠期间仅接触 ZIKV 的母亲相比,同时感染 ZIKV 和 CHIKV 的母亲所生的孩子所生的不良影响的频率或类型没有差异。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 众所周知,怀孕期间感染寨卡病毒 (ZIKV) 会导致先天性缺陷,但同时感染 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 的额外影响仍不清楚。这项研究通过比较怀孕期间单独感染 ZIKV 的母亲与同时感染 ZIKV 和 CHIKV 的母亲之间的不良婴儿结局,解决了知识差距。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 巴西伯南布哥州于2015年至2017年间开展了一项名为队列研究的前瞻性研究,纳入报告出现皮疹并向战略健康监测信息中心报告的孕妇。参与者居住在距离累西腓120公里范围内,新生儿由微小头畸形疫情研究小组的专家进行监测。该研究共纳入278名儿童,其中198名仅暴露于寨卡病毒(ZIKV),80名同时暴露于寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)。
analysis_zh.methods: 对孕妇进行了 ZIKV 和 CHIKV 的实验室检测,并使用描述性统计数据和相对风险 (RR) 比较了两个暴露组之间婴儿的不良后果。专家的标准化评估用于评估小头畸形、低出生体重、早产和神经异常等结果。
analysis_zh.main_results: 各组之间在小头畸形、低出生体重、早产、小于胎龄、吞咽困难、神经、眼科、听力或神经影像学异常的风险方面没有观察到显着差异。研究发现,与在怀孕期间仅接触 ZIKV 的母亲相比,同时感染 ZIKV 和 CHIKV 的母亲所生的孩子所生的不良反应的频率或类型没有差异。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,这些发现表明,并发 CHIKV 感染不会加剧妊娠期间与 ZIKV 单一感染相关的不良后果。新颖之处在于直接比较预期 队列研究 中的混合感染与单一感染,解决了之前未充分研究的问题。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,监测 和 ZIKV 暴露妊娠的临床管理可能不需要针对并发 CHIKV 感染进行修改。这支持了在两种病毒共同传播的地区仅针对 ZIKV 的有针对性的公共卫生战略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到观察设计、潜在的无法测量的混杂因素以及缺乏随机性的限制,从而限制了因果推断。由于样本量相对较小,并且依赖描述性比较和基于 RR 的比较,且未对混杂因素进行调整,因此证据强度中等。

papers.title: Áreas de risco para arboviroses (Dengue, Zika e Chikungunya) como indicador na gestão do saneamento a partir de análises geoespaciais Risk areas for arboviruses (Dengue, Zika and Chikungunya) as an indicator in sanitation management based on geospatial analysis Zonas de riesgo de arbovirosis (Dengue, Zika y Chikungunya) como indicador en la gestión del saneamiento basado en análisis geoespacial
papers.abstract: A universalização do saneamento necessita de metodologias que facilitem sua gestão. Objetivou-se analisar a conexão entre arboviroses e a ausência de saneamento como um indicador de gestão a partir de ferramentas do geoprocessamento. O município do Recife, Pernambuco, foi a área de estudo. Utilizou-se da estimativa de Densidade Kernel, do Índice de Moran e do Modelo de Cadeia de Markov para as análises. Foi utilizada média ponderada das relações dos Indicadores Locais de Associação Espacial, para definir as áreas prioritárias de ação. O Índice de Moran variou entre 0,283 e 0,472, com média de 0,361, apontando autocorrelação espacial positiva moderada entre as variáveis. Pela Cadeia de Markov, predominam manutenções de estados ou transições para “Não Significante”, com destaque para a manutenção de 49% da classe Alto-Alto. Os resultados apontam que a concentração espacial das arboviroses reproduz áreas vulneráveis, sustentando seu uso como indicador territorial de saneamento.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the need for methodologies to facilitate the management of universal sanitation by examining the connection between arboviruses and inadequate sanitation as a territorial indicator.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research focused on the municipality of Recife, Pernambuco, Brazil, using geospatial analysis tools to assess risk areas for arboviruses.
analysis.methods: Geoprocessing techniques included Kernel Density estimation, Moran's Index, and the Markov Chain Model to analyze spatial autocorrelation and transitions between risk states.
analysis.main_results: Moran's Index ranged from 0.283 to 0.472, with a mean of 0.361, indicating moderate positive spatial autocorrelation between arbovirus risk and sanitation indicators. Markov Chain analysis showed predominant maintenance of states or transitions to 'Non-Significant', with 49% of the High-High class remaining stable.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the spatial concentration of arboviruses as reflecting vulnerable areas, supporting their use as territorial indicators of sanitation management.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that arbovirus risk mapping can inform targeted sanitation interventions and public health resource allocation in urban settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its ecological design and reliance on secondary data, which restricts causal inference and generalizability to individual-level risk.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed the relationship between arbovirus risk areas (Dengue, Zika, and Chikungunya) and sanitation gaps in Recife, Brazil, using geospatial methods. Kernel Density, Moran's Index, and Markov Chain analyses revealed moderate positive spatial autocorrelation between arbovirus risk and sanitation indicators, with 49% of high-risk areas remaining stable. The authors propose that arbovirus risk mapping can serve as a territorial indicator for sanitation management, guiding targeted public health interventions. However, the ecological design and use of secondary data limit causal conclusions and generalizability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究通过检查虫媒病毒与卫生设施不足之间的联系作为地域指标,解决了对促进普遍卫生设施管理的方法的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究重点关注巴西伯南布哥州累西腓市,利用地理空间分析工具评估虫媒病毒的风险区域。
elements_zh.methods: 地理处理技术包括核密度估计、莫兰指数和马尔可夫链模型,用于分析空间自相关和风险状态之间的转换。
elements_zh.main_results: 莫兰指数范围为 0.283 至 0.472,平均值为 0.361,表明虫媒病毒风险与卫生指标之间存在中等正空间自相关。马尔可夫链分析显示,主要维持状态或转变为“非显着”,49% 的高-高类别保持稳定。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将虫媒病毒的空间集中性解释为反映了脆弱地区,支持将其用作卫生管理的领土指标。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,虫媒病毒风险图可以为城市环境中的有针对性的卫生干预措施和公共卫生资源分配提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其生态设计和对二手数据的依赖而受到限制,这限制了因果推断和对个人层面风险的普遍适用性。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the need for methodologies to facilitate the management of universal sanitation by examining the connection between arboviruses and inadequate sanitation as a territorial indicator.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The research focused on the municipality of Recife, Pernambuco, Brazil, using geospatial analysis tools to assess risk areas for arboviruses.
analysis_en.methods: Geoprocessing techniques included Kernel Density estimation, Moran's Index, and the Markov Chain Model to analyze spatial autocorrelation and transitions between risk states.
analysis_en.main_results: Moran's Index ranged from 0.283 to 0.472, with a mean of 0.361, indicating moderate positive spatial autocorrelation between arbovirus risk and sanitation indicators. Markov Chain analysis showed predominant maintenance of states or transitions to 'Non-Significant', with 49% of the High-High class remaining stable.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the spatial concentration of arboviruses as reflecting vulnerable areas, supporting their use as territorial indicators of sanitation management.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that arbovirus risk mapping can inform targeted sanitation interventions and public health resource allocation in urban settings.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its ecological design and reliance on secondary data, which restricts causal inference and generalizability to individual-level risk.

papers.source_body_en: A universalização do saneamento necessita de metodologias que facilitem sua gestão. O município do Recife, Pernambuco, foi a área de estudo. Utilizou-se da estimativa de Densidade Kernel, do Índice de Moran e do Modelo de Cadeia de Markov para as análises. Foi utilizada média ponderada das relações dos Indicadores Locais de Associação Espacial, para definir as áreas prioritárias de ação. O Índice de Moran variou entre 0,283 e 0,472, com média de 0,361, apontando autocorrelação espacial positiva moderada entre as variáveis. Pela Cadeia de Markov, predominam manutenções de estados ou transições para “Não Significante”, com destaque para a manutenção de 49% da classe Alto-Alto. Os resultados apontam que a concentração espacial das arboviroses reproduz áreas vulneráveis, sustentando seu uso como indicador territorial de saneamento.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the regulatory restriction placed on IXCHIQ (Chikungunya vaccine (live)), which limits its use to individuals at high risk of acquiring chikungunya infection. The rationale is to mitigate potential risks associated with the vaccine while targeting populations most likely to benefit from protection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a regulatory safety notice summarizing the restriction on IXCHIQ use, issued by the Health Products Regulatory Authority (HPRA) in Ireland on July 30, 2026. The population of interest is individuals identified as being at high risk of chikungunya infection.
analysis.methods: The method involves a regulatory assessment and issuance of a safety notice by the HPRA, which evaluates the risk-benefit profile of IXCHIQ and restricts its use to high-risk individuals. The notice is published in Reactions Weekly, a peer-reviewed journal.
analysis.main_results: The main result is the issuance of a regulatory restriction limiting IXCHIQ use to individuals at high risk of chikungunya infection, as communicated by the HPRA on July 30, 2026.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the restriction as a precautionary measure to ensure the safe use of IXCHIQ in populations where the risk of chikungunya infection justifies vaccination. The novelty lies in the targeted restriction, which emphasizes risk stratification rather than broad eligibility.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform public health policy by guiding the targeted use of the chikungunya vaccine, ensuring that high-risk individuals receive protection while minimizing potential risks. This supports evidence-based vaccination strategies for chikungunya prevention.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to a regulatory safety notice and lacks detailed clinical or epidemiological data. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as it relies on a single regulatory source without independent validation or broader study context.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the regulatory restriction imposed on IXCHIQ (Chikungunya vaccine (live)), which limits its use to individuals at high risk of chikungunya infection. Issued by the Health Products Regulatory Authority (HPRA) in Ireland on July 30, 2026, the restriction aims to balance vaccine safety with targeted protection for high-risk populations. The notice, published in Reactions Weekly, reflects a precautionary approach to chikungunya vaccination. While the restriction provides clear guidance for public health policy, the evidence is derived solely from a regulatory source and lacks detailed clinical or epidemiological data, resulting in a moderate strength of evidence.

papers.full_text: Abstract Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is endemic in Myanmar and remains an important cause of arboviral febrile illness. However, cytokine responses during CHIKV infection in Myanmar remain poorly characterized. In this study, serum cytokine profiles were analyzed in CHIKV RT–qPCR-positive patients using the Human Cytokine Magnetic 10-Plex Panel. Seven cytokines were detectable, including IFN-γ, TNF-α, IL-4, IL-6, IL-8, IL-10, and GM-CSF. Compared with healthy controls, all detectable cytokines except TNF-α were significantly elevated in CHIKV-infected patients. Cytokine concentrations varied according to patient’s viral load and clinical presentation. These findings demonstrate distinct inflammatory and regulatory cytokine responses during CHIKV infection and provide insights into host immune responses in Myanmar CHIKV patients. Further studies are needed to clarify the cytokine responses associated with disease severity and viral burden. Abbreviations - CHIKV: - Chikungunya virus - DENV: - Dengue virus - GM-CSF: - Granulocyte–macrophage colony-stimulating factor - IFN-γ: - Interferon-gamma - IL: - Interleukin - RT–qPCR: - Reverse transcription–quantitative polymerase chain reaction - TNF-α: - Tumor necrosis factor-alpha Acknowledgements The authors would like to thank all study participants. We are grateful to the Department of Virology, Institute of Tropical Medicine, Nagasaki University, Dr Aung Kyaw Kyaw and members of the Department of Medical Research, Myanmar, and the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) for their support. However, cytokine responses during CHIKV infection in Myanmar remain poorly characterized. analysis.research_question_and_background: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is endemic in Myanmar and causes significant arboviral febrile illness, yet cytokine responses during infection in this setting remain poorly characterized. The study aimed to profile serum cytokine responses in RT–qPCR-confirmed CHIKV-infected patients to address this knowledge gap.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was a cross-sectional study of CHIKV RT–qPCR-positive patients in Myanmar, with serum cytokine profiles compared against healthy controls. Serum samples were collected under approved ethics protocols with written informed consent obtained from participants.
analysis.methods: Serum cytokine concentrations were measured using the Human Cytokine Magnetic 10-Plex Panel, which detected seven cytokines: IFN-γ, TNF-α, IL-4, IL-6, IL-8, IL-10, and GM-CSF. Serum samples were collected under consent permitting future arboviral research and reuse.
analysis.main_results: All detectable cytokines except TNF-α were significantly elevated in CHIKV-infected patients compared with healthy controls. Cytokine concentrations varied according to patient viral load and clinical presentation.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate distinct inflammatory and regulatory cytokine responses during CHIKV infection in Myanmar, providing new insights into host immune responses in this population. This is the first report of cytokine profiles in CHIKV-infected patients from Myanmar.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study identifies cytokine markers associated with CHIKV infection in Myanmar, which may inform the development of diagnostic biomarkers or therapeutic targets for chikungunya fever in endemic settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design and small sample size, and further research is needed to clarify cytokine responses associated with disease severity and viral burden. The evidence is moderate due to these constraints and the lack of mechanistic or longitudinal data.

analysis.summary_en: This study profiled serum cytokine responses in RT–qPCR-confirmed Chikungunya virus (CHIKV)-infected patients in Myanmar, comparing them to healthy controls using the Human Cytokine Magnetic 10-Plex Panel. Seven cytokines were detectable, with all except TNF-α significantly elevated in infected patients. Cytokine levels varied with viral load and clinical presentation, indicating distinct inflammatory and regulatory responses during CHIKV infection. This is the first report of cytokine profiles in CHIKV-infected patients from Myanmar, providing new insights into host immune responses in this endemic setting. The findings may inform the development of diagnostic biomarkers or therapeutic targets for chikungunya fever, though the study's cross-sectional design and small sample size limit generalisability and mechanistic interpretation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 在缅甸流行,并导致严重的虫媒病毒发热性疾病,但在这种情况下感染期间的细胞因子反应仍不清楚。该研究旨在分析 RT-qPCR 确诊的 CHIKV 感染患者的血清细胞因子反应,以弥补这一知识差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是一项针对缅甸 CHIKV RT-qPCR 阳性患者的横断面研究,将血清细胞因子谱与健康对照进行比较。血清样本是根据批准的伦理协议收集的,并获得了参与者的书面知情同意。
elements_zh.methods: 使用人类细胞因子磁性 10-Plex Panel 测量血清细胞因子浓度,该面板检测到七种细胞因子:IFN-γ、TNF-α、IL-4、IL-6、IL-8、IL-10 和 GM-CSF。血清样本是在同意允许未来虫媒病毒研究和再利用的情况下收集的。
elements_zh.main_results: 与健康对照相比,CHIKV 感染患者中除 TNF-α 外的所有可检测到的细胞因子均显着升高。细胞因子浓度根据患者病毒载量和临床表现而变化。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,缅甸 CHIKV 感染期间存在明显的炎症和调节性细胞因子反应,为了解该人群中的 宿主 免疫应答 提供了新的见解。这是缅甸 CHIKV 感染患者细胞因子谱的第一份报告。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究确定了与缅甸 CHIKV 感染相关的细胞因子标记物,这可能为流行病环境下 基孔肯雅热 诊断生物标记物或治疗靶点的开发提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横断面设计和小样本量的限制,需要进一步研究来阐明与疾病严重程度和病毒负荷相关的细胞因子反应。由于这些限制以及缺乏机械或纵向数据,证据是中等的。

papers.title: The disappearance, and re-emergence of Aedes aegypti in Iran: historical and current status, rising dengue fever threat
papers.abstract: Aedes aegypti is the proven vector of dengue fever, Zika, chikungunya, and yellow fever. In Iran, the first recorded sighting of Ae. aegypti dates back to 1920 and into the early 1950s. For 70 years, the species was not seen in the country. However, since 2018, reports have confirmed the presence of Ae. aegypti in various regions. It is now established in some areas of the southern provinces, including Hormozgan, Bushehr, and Sistan and Baluchistan. The appearance, disappearance, and subsequent re-emergence of Ae. aegypti in Iran, after a 70-year absence, are attributed to a combination of factors such as historical malaria control, infrastructure, globalization, urbanization, and climate change that is discussed in this study. This study underscores that the re-emergence of Ae. aegypti in Iran necessitates an urgent paradigm shift from reactive chemical-based control toward a proactive, integrated management framework. Ultimately, the long-term mitigation of dengue fever risk depends on the seamless integration of community-based environmental management with advanced biotechnological interventions.

source_records.abstract: Aedes aegypti is the proven vector of dengue fever, Zika, chikungunya, and yellow fever. In Iran, the first recorded sighting of Ae. aegypti dates back to 1920 and into the early 1950s. For 70 years, the species was not seen in the country. However, since 2018, reports have confirmed the presence of Ae. aegypti in various regions. It is now established in some areas of the southern provinces, including Hormozgan, Bushehr, and Sistan and Baluchistan. The appearance, disappearance, and subsequent re-emergence of Ae. aegypti in Iran, after a 70-year absence, are attributed to a combination of factors such as historical malaria control, infrastructure, globalization, urbanization, and climate change that is discussed in this study. This study underscores that the re-emergence of Ae. aegypti in Iran necessitates an urgent paradigm shift from reactive chemical-based control toward a proactive, integrated management framework. Ultimately, the long-term mitigation of dengue fever risk depends on the seamless integration of community-based environmental management with advanced biotechnological interventions.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the public-health threat posed by the re-emergence of Aedes aegypti in Iran after a 70-year absence and the risk of dengue fever transmission it introduces. It frames the problem by noting Ae. aegypti’s role as a proven vector of dengue fever and other arboviruses and highlights the knowledge gap regarding the drivers of its disappearance and re-emergence in the country.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The paper is a historical and current-status review of Ae. aegypti in Iran, synthesizing published records and reports from 1920 to 2026. It focuses on southern provinces where the species has become established, including Hormozgan, Bushehr, and Sistan and Baluchistan.
analysis.methods: The study compiles historical sightings, absence periods, and recent confirmations of Ae. aegypti using published reports and surveillance data. It attributes the species’ dynamics to factors such as malaria control programs, infrastructure changes, globalization, urbanization, and climate change.
analysis.main_results: The evidence shows Ae. aegypti was first recorded in Iran in 1920–1950, disappeared for 70 years, and has been confirmed since 2018 in multiple southern regions, where it is now established in Hormozgan, Bushehr, and Sistan and Baluchistan.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the re-emergence as driven by ecological and anthropogenic changes and argue that current vector control must shift from reactive chemical-based approaches to proactive, integrated management. They emphasize the need for community-based environmental management combined with biotechnological tools to mitigate dengue risk.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings signal an urgent need to strengthen surveillance and adopt integrated vector management in southern Iran to prevent autochthonous dengue transmission. They also highlight the importance of addressing climate change, urbanization, and globalization in arbovirus risk assessments.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on a narrative review of published reports and surveillance summaries, which limits causal inference and generalizability beyond documented regions. The evidence strength is moderate due to the absence of primary entomological sampling, standardized case data, or quantitative risk modeling.

analysis.summary_en: This review traces the historical presence, 70-year absence, and recent re-emergence of Aedes aegypti in southern Iran, where the species is now established in Hormozgan, Bushehr, and Sistan and Baluchistan. The authors attribute its return to malaria control programs, infrastructure changes, globalization, urbanization, and climate change. They argue for a shift from reactive chemical control to proactive, integrated vector management and call for combining community-based environmental measures with biotechnological interventions to mitigate dengue risk. The study’s moderate evidence strength reflects its reliance on published reports and surveillance summaries rather than primary entomological or epidemiological data.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本文是对 Ae 的历史和现状的回顾。伊朗的埃及伊蚊,综合了 1920 年至 2026 年已发表的记录和报告。它重点关注该物种已定居的南部省份,包括霍尔木兹甘、布什尔、锡斯坦和俾路支斯坦。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究汇编了 Ae 的历史目击事件、缺席时间和最近的确认。aegypti 使用已发布的报告和 监测 数据。它将物种的动态归因于疟疾控制计划、基础设施变化、全球化、城市化和气候变化等因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 证据显示Ae。埃及伊蚊于 1920 年至 1950 年在伊朗首次被记录,消失了 70 年,自 2018 年以来在多个南部地区得到证实,目前在霍尔木兹甘、布什尔、锡斯坦和俾路支斯坦都有发现。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,伊朗南部迫切需要加强 监测 并采取综合 媒介 管理,以预防本土登革热 传播。他们还强调了虫媒病毒风险评估中应对气候变化、城市化和全球化的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于对已发表报告和 监测 摘要的叙述性审查,这限制了有记录的区域之外的因果推断和普遍性。由于缺乏初级昆虫学采样、标准化病例数据或定量风险模型,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Cross-Family Mechanistic Analysis of Plant Alkaloids Against Neglected Arboviruses and Related RNA Viruses
papers.abstract: Neglected arboviruses dengue (DENV), Zika (ZIKV), yellow fever (YFV), Japanese encephalitis (JEV), and chikungunya collectively affect hundreds of millions of people annually, yet no specific antiviral drug has been approved for any of them. Alkaloids, nitrogen-containing specialized metabolites produced by diverse plant families, have emerged as a promising source of broad-spectrum antiviral scaffolds. This review compiles and critically analyzes over 100 alkaloid-virus pairs across several RNA virus families, providing a comparative mechanistic analysis. Lycorine, narciclasine, emetine, and berbamine, among others, exhibit potent activity against phylogenetically distant viruses, with the most potent activities reported against flaviviruses (narciclasine: EC50 0.02 μM against DENV, ZIKV, YFV, and JEV; pancratistatine: 0.0063 μM against ZIKV). Structure-activity analysis of multiple alkaloid classes identifies key pharmacophoric features, including the phenanthridine nucleus (lycorine derivatives) and the bis-benzylisoquinoline scaffold (tetrandrine, berbamine), as determinants of antiviral potency, selectivity, and broad-spectrum activity. Genetic resistance data in West Nile virus challenge the widely accepted model of lycorine as a direct nucleoside inhibitor, instead pointing toward the involvement of the membrane-associated NS4A-2K-NS4B replication complex, though direct validation remains limited for other flaviviruses. Converging structural, biochemical, and transcriptomic evidence suggests that ribosome-mediated translational stress may represent an additional host-directed antiviral mechanism for isoquinoline-type alkaloids, though the causal chain from ribosome binding to activation of the integrated stress response and to antiviral effect has not been established. The present analysis highlights that in vivo validation remains limited to a few alkaloid-virus pairs. Unbiased target deconvolution and formal testing of the ribosome/integrated stress response hypothesis stand out as essential research priorities.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), chikungunya disease, and recognized CHIKV lineages. The central question is to evaluate the antiviral potential of plant alkaloids against CHIKV and related RNA viruses, with an emphasis on mechanistic insights and therapeutic implications.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review compiles and critically analyzes over 100 alkaloid-virus pairs across several RNA virus families, including CHIKV. papers.title_zh: 植物生物碱对抗被忽视的虫媒病毒和相关 RNA 病毒的跨科机制分析
papers.source_body_en: Neglected arboviruses dengue (DENV), Zika (ZIKV), yellow fever (YFV), Japanese encephalitis (JEV), and chikungunya collectively affect hundreds of millions of people annually, yet no specific antiviral drug has been approved for any of them. Alkaloids, nitrogen-containing specialized metabolites produced by diverse plant families, have emerged as a promising source of broad-spectrum antiviral scaffolds. This review compiles and critically analyzes over 100 alkaloid-virus pairs across several RNA virus families, providing a comparative mechanistic analysis. Lycorine, narciclasine, emetine, and berbamine, among others, exhibit potent activity against phylogenetically distant viruses, with the most potent activities reported against flaviviruses (narciclasine: EC50 0.02 μM against DENV, ZIKV, YFV, and JEV; pancratistatine: 0.0063 μM against ZIKV). Structure-activity analysis of multiple alkaloid classes identifies key pharmacophoric features, including the phenanthridine nucleus (lycorine derivatives) and the bis-benzylisoquinoline scaffold (tetrandrine, berbamine), as determinants of antiviral potency, selectivity, and broad-spectrum activity. Genetic resistance data in West Nile virus challenge the widely accepted model of lycorine as a direct nucleoside inhibitor, instead pointing toward the involvement of the membrane-associated NS4A-2K-NS4B replication complex, though direct validation remains limited for other flaviviruses. Converging structural, biochemical, and transcriptomic evidence suggests that ribosome-mediated translational stress may represent an additional host-directed antiviral mechanism for isoquinoline-type alkaloids, though the causal chain from ribosome binding to activation of the integrated stress response and to antiviral effect has not been established. The present analysis highlights that in vivo validation remains limited to a few alkaloid-virus pairs. Unbiased target deconvolution and formal testing of the ribosome/integrated stress response hypothesis stand out as essential research priorities.
papers.abstract_zh: 被忽视的虫媒病毒登革热 (DENV)、寨卡病毒 (ZIKV)、黄热病 (YFV)、日本脑炎 (JEV) 和基孔肯雅热每年共同影响数亿人,但尚未批准针对其中任何一种的特定 抗病毒药物 药物。生物碱是由不同植物科产生的含氮专门代谢物,已成为广谱 抗病毒药物 支架的有前途的来源。这篇综述编译并严格分析了多个 RNA 病毒家族的 100 多个生物碱病毒对,提供了比较机制分析。石蒜碱、水仙环素、依米丁和小檗胺等对系统发育较远的病毒表现出有效的活性,其中针对黄病毒的活性最强(水仙环素:针对 DENV、ZIKV、YFV 和 JEV 的 EC50 0.02 μM;pancratistatin:针对 ZIKV 的 EC50 0.0063 μM)。多种生物碱类别的结构活性分析确定了关键药效团特征,包括菲啶核(石蒜碱衍生物)和双苄基异喹啉支架(粉防己碱、小檗胺),作为 抗病毒药物 效力、选择性和广谱活性的决定因素。西尼罗河病毒的遗传抗性数据挑战了广泛接受的石蒜碱作为直接核苷抑制剂的模型,而是指出膜相关的 NS4A-2K-NS4B 复制复合物的参与,尽管对其他黄病毒的直接验证仍然有限。结构、生化和转录组证据表明,核糖体介导的翻译应激可能代表异喹啉型生物碱的另一种 宿主 导向的 抗病毒药物 机制,尽管从核糖体结合到整合应激反应激活和 抗病毒药物 效应的因果链尚未建立。目前的分析强调,体内验证仍然仅限于少数生物碱-病毒对。无偏目标反卷积和核糖体/综合应激反应假说的正式测试是重要的研究重点。

papers.title: App-Based Mosquito Surveillance and Community Engagement in St. Louis: Insights from a Mixed-Methods Study Evaluation of the Mosquito Alert St. Louis Initiative
papers.abstract: Mosquito-borne diseases, including malaria and viruses such as dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and West Nile, cause more than 700,000 deaths globally each year. Louis (MASTL) is the first United States (US) project to promote the public use of the Mosquito Alert app, a participatory surveillance platform developed in Barcelona, Spain. The app enables residents to report mosquito sightings, bites, and breeding sites by uploading photos, which entomologists and public health officials review. This exploratory mixed method study evaluated early implementation and institutionalization of MASTL. Quantitative surveys were conducted with individuals who engaged with the project (n = 37) or participated in a virtual webinar (n = 98). Webinar results showed an increase in knowledge and perceptions about mosquitoes and mosquito control consistent with our messaging; downloads and use of the Mosquito Alert app itself remained limited, however. Qualitative interviews (n = 11) with representatives from community organizations assessed feasibility and strategies for community partnerships and institutionalization. Findings indicated strong alignment between MASTL and community organizations’ missions and need for improved app training, outreach materials, and sustained partnerships. We conclude that engagement with the MASTL project was highest among environmentally conscious community members, and engagement with our educational outreach served to reinforce and heighten awareness and perceptions consistent with our outreach messages. The MASTL app can enhance engagement, and combining it with educational interventions and long-term collaboration with community organizations can promote ecological mosquito control and prevention among community members, strengthen public health impact, and advance community-based vector surveillance.

papers.title_zh: 圣路易斯基于应用程序的 Mosquito 监测 和社区参与:来自对 Mosquito Alert St. Louis Initiative 的混合方法研究评估的见解
papers.source_body_en: Mosquito-borne diseases, including malaria and viruses such as dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and West Nile, cause more than 700,000 deaths globally each year. Louis (MASTL) is the first United States (US) project to promote the public use of the Mosquito Alert app, a participatory surveillance platform developed in Barcelona, Spain. The app enables residents to report mosquito sightings, bites, and breeding sites by uploading photos, which entomologists and public health officials review. This exploratory mixed method study evaluated early implementation and institutionalization of MASTL. Quantitative surveys were conducted with individuals who engaged with the project (n = 37) or participated in a virtual webinar (n = 98). Webinar results showed an increase in knowledge and perceptions about mosquitoes and mosquito control consistent with our messaging; downloads and use of the Mosquito Alert app itself remained limited, however. Qualitative interviews (n = 11) with representatives from community organizations assessed feasibility and strategies for community partnerships and institutionalization. Findings indicated strong alignment between MASTL and community organizations’ missions and need for improved app training, outreach materials, and sustained partnerships. We conclude that engagement with the MASTL project was highest among environmentally conscious community members, and engagement with our educational outreach served to reinforce and heighten awareness and perceptions consistent with our outreach messages. The MASTL app can enhance engagement, and combining it with educational interventions and long-term collaboration with community organizations can promote ecological mosquito control and prevention among community members, strengthen public health impact, and advance community-based vector surveillance.

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该研究的重点是评估圣路易斯蚊子警报 (MASTL) 计划的实施和制度化,该计划旨在使用蚊子 监测 和社区参与的应用程序来对抗蚊媒疾病,包括 基孔肯雅病毒。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该研究是一项探索性混合方法评估。对参与该项目 (n = 37) 或参加虚拟网络研讨会 (n = 98) 的个人进行了定量调查。与社区组织代表的定性访谈(n = 11)评估了社区伙伴关系和制度化的可行性和策略。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 研究发现,具有环保意识的社区成员对 MASTL 项目的参与度最高。教育宣传加强和提高了人们对蚊子和蚊子控制的认识,与该项目的信息保持一致。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 尽管网络研讨会结果增加了人们对蚊子和蚊子控制的了解和认识,但该应用程序的下载和使用仍然有限。需要改进应用程序培训、宣传材料和持续的合作伙伴关系来提高参与度。

papers.title: Evidence of dengue transmission and a diverse Aedes mosquito virome on the Congo’s Angola border
papers.abstract: Abstract Aedes mosquitoes are widely distributed across the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), and are major vectors of dengue (DENV), Zika, chikungunya (CHIKV), and yellow fever (YFV) viruses. While the high burden of malaria in the DRC receives considerable attention, arboviruses remain understudied. In the setting of recent CHIKV and YFV outbreaks in southwestern DRC, we collect Aedes mosquitoes in three areas of Kimpese, DRC, near the Angola border, to investigate their virome. Metagenomic and targeted sequencing of eight randomly selected field mosquito pools, comprising 155 mosquitoes from three collection sites, confirm high-confidence DENV reads and human blood meals in six (75%) and eight (100%) pools, respectively. We find diverse mosquito viromes including other known and putative human and animal viruses. Our findings provide strong evidence of endemic DENV transmission along the DRC-Angola border and illustrate the potential of wild-caught mosquitoes for xenosurveillance of emerging pathogens.

papers.title: Knowledge, attitudes, practices regarding vector-borne diseases among adults in Switzerland: a cross-sectional survey
papers.abstract: Background : Vector-borne diseases (VBDs) are an evolving public health concern in Switzerland, where endemic tick-borne infections coexist with emerging mosquito-borne threats linked to climate and ecological change. Public preparedness depends on population knowledge, risk perception, and preventive behaviour alongside institutional capacity. We assessed knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) regarding VBDs among adults in the canton of Bern, interpreted alongside a complementary national stakeholder survey. Methods : We analysed a 2025 cross-sectional web-based survey embedded in the BEready cohort. After validity screening, we derived a latent knowledge score using a two-parameter logistic item response theory (IRT) model fitted to knowledge items. Multivariable linear regression examined associations between participant characteristics and latent knowledge. We identified KAP profiles through partitioning-around-medoids clustering based on block-weighted Gower dissimilarities. A parallel survey of cantonal and Liechtenstein authorities in human health, animal health, and environment departments provided institutional context. Results : Among 1,847 respondents, 1,337 met validity criteria. Knowledge was strongest for tick-related content: 98% matched tick-borne encephalitis to ticks, 87% did so for Lyme disease. Mosquito-borne knowledge was markedly weaker, with only 36% correctly classifying chikungunya and 43% West Nile fever as mosquito-borne, despite 53 % reporting at least weekly summer mosquito exposure. Tick checks were reported by 79% of participants versus 30% for mosquito standing-water removal. The IRT model indicated that mosquito-borne items were both hardest and most discriminating. Higher knowledge was associated with educational attainment, female sex, residence history, tick-bite frequency, and travel history, alongside a non-linear age effect peaking in mid-adulthood. Clustering identified six KAP profiles distinguishing knowledge gaps, low perceived relevance, and weak translation of knowledge into practice. The stakeholder survey (n=55) showed institutional engagement was considerably more developed for mosquito-borne than tick-borne diseases, although about half of authorities reported no dedicated human resources (49%) or budget (55%). Conclusion : Public knowledge and practice remain stronger for tick-borne than mosquito-borne diseases, despite frequent mosquito exposure, revealing a communication gap. Institutional preparedness shows the opposite pattern, being more developed for mosquito-borne threats. Public health strategies should sustain effective tick-prevention messaging while strengthening mosquito-borne disease communication, household source reduction, and support for community-level surveillance and control.
